interaction_phrase: launch a $90 million quantum computing initiative
occurrence_sentence: PASQAL announced the launch of a $90 million quantum technology initiative over five years in Sherbrooke, Quebec.

The Government of Quebec is providing a $15 million loan in connection with this investment project for the establishment of PASQAL SAS's subsidiary in the quantum innovation zone, DISTRIQ, based in Sherbrooke.
The CEO of PASQAL, Georges-Olivier Reymond, Chief Technical Officer Loïc Henriet, co-founders Christophe Jurczak and Nobel Prize laureate Alain Aspect, were also present.
